final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response materially narrows the claim and correctly treats prior approval and informal monitoring as insufficient, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new proof. The controlling policy predicate remains unmet on the evidence available here: certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. Neither the current-release documentation artifact nor the disclosure text nor an approved mitigation/risk-acceptance artifact is in evidence. That distinction matters: a caveated policy-bounded theory of compliance is not enough for compliant_with_caveats unless the caveat itself is evidenced as satisfied. Here it is not.
